welcome.welcomeTitle: 📖 Welcome to the world of books – read, upload, and share!
welcome.welcomeText1: Reading is not just a hobby, it’s a whole world that opens up to anyone who picks up a book. Some love immersing themselves in classical works, enjoying the refined style of past authors, while others prefer modern literature filled with dynamic plots and vivid emotions.
welcome.welcomeText2: Our site is created for everyone who values books and wants free access to knowledge and entertainment. Here you can <1>read, download, and upload</1> books <3>completely free</3>.
welcome.searchText: We've built a library where you'll find books <1>in various formats – PDF, EPUB, FB2, MOBI, and more</1>. This means you can choose your preferred reading method – smartphone screen, e-reader, or computer.

searchList.classic: 📚 <1>Classical literature</1> – timeless works that remain relevant forever.
searchList.bestsellers: 🔥 <1>Modern bestsellers</1> – books loved by millions of readers around the world.
searchList.nonFiction: 📖 <1>Non-fiction</1> – books that help you learn, grow, and find new ideas.
searchList.genres: ✨ <1>Fantasy, sci-fi, detective stories, romance</1>, scientific papers, self-development books, and much more.
searchList.fanfics: 📝 <1>Fanfics</1> – alternative stories and creative reimaginings of beloved universes.

welcome.shareText1: Our project is open to everyone! If you have an interesting book you'd like to share, <1>upload it</1>. The administration will review your file or request and add it to the library so other readers can enjoy it too.
welcome.shareWarning: 💡 <1>Important!</1> Before submitting a book, be sure to read the <3>upload rules</3>. We monitor content quality and respect copyright.
welcome.shareText2: 📚 Discover the endless world of books! Read with pleasure, find new stories, share your favorite works, and enjoy the magic of words! 🚀
